purpose: patterns adopted for ordinary-chat task execution; evidence is not vendored code

adopted: separate task lifecycle from transport/capability layer
explicit task handles/receipts rather than assuming one synchronous call equals completion

observed: DynamicToolset could silently lose durable wrapping
adopted: do not infer durability from configuration presence; prove replay behavior

observed: non-idempotent tool calls could re-execute on flow retry when replay caching failed
adopted: resume gate requires zero step re-execution and zero new diff

observed: unbounded per-turn tool-call fanout caused production failures
adopted: dependency graph rather than unrestricted fanout
